name: Name
label: Label
defaultOutboundSet: {name} is now the default outbound configuration
pageDescription: Connect one or more telephony provider accounts. Each campaign uses one configuration; inbound calls are routed to the right one by account ID.
telnyxWebhookKeyWarning: {count, plural, one {# Telnyx configuration is} other {# Telnyx configurations are}} missing a webhook public key. Without it, Telnyx call status updates and inbound calls are being rejected. Copy your public key from <key>Mission Control Portal → Keys & Credentials → Public Key</key> and paste it into the affected Telnyx configuration below.
vonageSignatureWarning: {count, plural, one {# Vonage configuration is} other {# Vonage configurations are}} missing a signature secret. Without it, Vonage signed webhooks are rejected, so inbound calls and call status updates will not work. Copy the signature secret from your Vonage account and paste it into the affected Vonage configuration below.
yourConfigurationsDescription: Manage telephony provider accounts and their phone numbers.
noConfigurationsHint: Add one to enable outbound calls and receive inbound calls.
phoneCount: {count, plural, one {# phone number} other {# phone numbers}}
deleteConfigurationDescription: {name} and all of its phone numbers will be removed. Any campaigns that reference this configuration will block the deletion until they are reassigned.
defaultCallerSet: {address} is now the default caller ID
configDisabledBody: Dograh stopped reconnecting after repeated connection failures{reason}. Calls will not work until it is reconnected. Correct the settings below, then choose Reactivate to try again.
stasisTitle: Route calls into this Stasis application
stasisHint: Add this line to your Asterisk extensions.conf, then run dialplan reload. Until you do, calls reach Asterisk but never arrive at Dograh.
clickToCopyInboundWebhook: Click to copy inbound webhook URL
phoneNumbersDescription: Numbers used as caller ID for outbound and accepted for inbound matching. SIP URIs and extensions are supported alongside PSTN numbers.
noPhoneNumbers: No phone numbers yet. Add one to start placing or receiving calls on this configuration.
clickToCopyPhoneNumberId: Click to copy phone number ID
deletePhoneNumberDescription: {address} will no longer accept inbound calls or be available as a caller ID for this configuration.
editTelephonyDescription: Update credentials for this configuration. Phone numbers are managed separately.
addTelephonyDescription: Connect a telephony provider account. Phone numbers are added after the configuration is created.
providerLocked: Provider cannot be changed after creation.
setAsDefaultForOutbound: Set as default for outbound calls
defaultOutboundHint: Used by test calls and campaigns when no specific config is selected.
noDefaultYetHint: Your organization has no default yet.
phoneNumbersManagedSeparately: Phone numbers are managed separately on the configuration page.
addressHintError: PSTN addresses without a leading '+' need a Country (ISO-2) hint, or include the country code in the address (e.g. +14155551234).
providerSyncFailed: Saved, but failed to sync inbound webhook to the provider.
phoneDialogDescription: PSTN numbers (E.164), SIP URIs (sip:user@host), and SIP extensions are all supported.
addressImmutable: Address cannot be changed. Delete this number and create a new one to change it.
inboundWorkflowHint: Used when per-number inbound routing is enabled. Today, inbound calls still route by the workflow_id in the webhook URL.
trunkHintMultiple: Calls from this number leave on this trunk. Pick the one whose carrier authorised the number — carriers reject a caller ID they do not own.
trunkHintSingle: Calls from this number leave on this trunk. With a single trunk Dograh falls back to it anyway.
defaultCallerIdLabel: Default caller ID for this configuration
defaultCallerIdHint: Used as the from-number for test calls when set.
setupDescriptionSip: Dograh provides the SIP connection; you connect your own carrier and numbers to it.
setupDescriptionDefault: Finish these steps to place and receive calls on this configuration.
outboundBlockedTitle: Outbound calls will not work yet
sipConnectivityDescription: The endpoints to give your SIP carrier or PBX. Pick a region to see the addresses that region uses.
inboundDescription: Route calls to {provider}/Dograh using this SIP endpoint.
outboundDescription: Send calls from {provider}/Dograh to your SIP carrier or PBX.
outboundTrunksDescription: Each trunk is one route to a carrier or PBX. Numbers listed under a trunk dial out on it; numbers with no trunk are managed in Phone numbers below.
noTrunks: No trunks yet. Add one pointing at your SIP carrier or PBX to place outbound calls on this configuration.
noNumbersOnTrunk: No numbers on this trunk yet.
trunkDialogDescription: Dograh provisions this trunk with {provider} and dials your carrier over it.
trunkEnabledHint: Calls are never routed over a disabled trunk.
deleteTrunkDescription: {name} will be deactivated with {provider} and calls will stop routing over it. Numbers still assigned to it must be moved first.
sipDomainHint: Your carrier or PBX. Used for both the SIP To header and the Request-URI.
regionHint: Sets the remote peer Dograh dials for this trunk.
regionOriginIpHint: Calls leave from {ip} — allow it on your side.
trunkNamePatternError: Trunk name may only contain letters, digits and hyphens
bodyTemplateHint: Use LLM parameters defined above with {param}, or initial context with {context}.
editCredentialDescription: Update this credential. Changes apply everywhere it is used.
addCredentialDescription: Create a credential for authenticating tools and webhooks.
replaceAuthenticationHint: Saved values are hidden. Leave this unchecked to keep them.
credentialDescription: Select a credential for authentication, or leave empty for no auth.
noCredentials: No credentials found. Click the + button to create one.
noParameters: No parameters defined. Add a parameter to specify what data this tool needs.
parameterNameHint: Name of the parameter, like "order_id" or "customer_name"
parameterTypeHint: Type of the parameter, like "string" or "number" or "boolean"
parameterDescriptionHint: Description of the parameter, which makes it easy for LLM to understand, like "The ID of the Customer to fetch Order Details"
parameterDescriptionPlaceholder: Describe what this parameter is for...
noPresetParameters: No preset parameters defined. Add one to inject a fixed value or workflow context into the request.
presetNameHint: Key sent to the API, like "phone_number" or "customer_id"
presetTypeHint: JSON type to send to the API
presetValueHint: Use a fixed value or a template like {phone} or {customer}
selectVoiceDescription: Preview voices, select one, then choose Use this voice.
customVoiceIdHint: Use a voice ID that isn't in the catalog above.
